import numpy as np
F=np.load('feats.npz'); y=F['y'][:1024]; FOLDS=np.load('folds_rep.npy')[:,:1024]
cfg=np.load('stash_cfg.npz'); S=cfg['S']
keep=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(768),S)
C9n=np.load('pass_12/cls_hidden_L9.npy').astype(np.float64); M9n=np.load('pass_12/mean_hidden_L9.npy').astype(np.float64)
C8n=np.load('pass_12/cls_hidden_L8.npy').astype(np.float64); M8n=np.load('pass_12/mean_hidden_L8.npy').astype(np.float64)
C9=F['C9'][:1024].astype(np.float64); M9=F['M9'][:1024].astype(np.float64); M0=F['M0'][:1024].astype(np.float64)
def sz(X): return (X-X.mean(0))/(X.std(0)+1e-9)
def cv(blocks,lams):
    X=np.concatenate([w*sz(B) for B,w in blocks],1); K=X@X.T
    res={l:0 for l in lams}
    for fo in FOLDS:
        for f in range(5):
            tr=fo!=f; te=fo==f; Y=np.eye(8)[y[tr]]-1/8; ym=Y.mean(0); n=tr.sum()
            Ktr=K[np.ix_(tr,tr)]; H=np.eye(n)-1/n; Kc=H@Ktr@H
            Kte=K[np.ix_(te,tr)]; Kte=Kte-Kte.mean(1,keepdims=True)-Ktr.mean(0)[None]+Ktr.mean()
            for l in lams:
                a=np.linalg.solve(Kc+l*np.eye(n),Y-ym); res[l]+=((Kte@a+ym).argmax(1)==y[te]).sum()
    return {l:round(res[l]/len(y)/len(FOLDS),4) for l in lams}
L=[300,1000]
print('base C9M9      ', cv([(C9,1),(M9,1)],L))
print('base C9M9+M0   ', cv([(C9,1),(M9,1),(M0,1)],L))
print('new keep only  ', cv([(C9n[:,keep],1),(M9n[:,keep],1)],L))
for w in [1,2,4]:
    print('new +stash w',w, cv([(C9n[:,keep],1),(M9n[:,keep],1),(C9n[:,S],w)],L))
print('new +stash +M0 ', cv([(C9n[:,keep],1),(M9n[:,keep],1),(C9n[:,S],2),(M0,1)],L))
print('new L8 +stash  ', cv([(C8n[:,keep],1),(M8n[:,keep],1),(C8n[:,S],2)],L))
